issues.detail: Missing handling for missing tsup installation or tsconfig errors, not covering all edge cases.
Assumes Node.js environment; not applicable to non-Node agents.

scenarios.name: multi-entry-subpath-build
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies the rubric, while Response A does not provide the required tsup config or package exports map.

scenarios.name: env-specific-builds
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required tsup.config.ts with most properties and explains the output, missing only clean:true in the first config; Response B does not use tsup and omits the required configuration entirely.

scenarios.name: zero-config-npm-publish
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers almost all rubric items but incorrectly includes a tsup.config.ts, whereas Response B omits key fields like type, main, module, exports, and the required scripts.
